{{Conjecture}}
A '''module''' of [[DarkStryder technology]] was capable of causing all [[Insect/Legends|insect]] and [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life in a fifty-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius to die. The module was ten [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] wide by sixteen centimeters long and was a dead crimson in color. Higher forms of life caught in the module's effects were injured by the effects. All of the life energy from those caught in the field was absorbed by the module's wielder. One of these modules was in the possession of [[Moff Sarne's forces]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Binaros]]. When his forces withdrew from the planet, the [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6-series repair droid]] [[MSE-X-PR6]] stole the module.
